responsibility: This file implements low-level RTL debug-value tracking support that preserves or reconstructs values referenced by DEBUG_INSNs as registers are transformed or become dead. It normalizes debug expressions by removing auto-inc/dec side effects, propagates substitutions through debug statements, records pending debug uses of dying registers, creates DEBUG_EXPR temporaries and VAR_LOCATION bindings when needed, and adjusts later debug uses to refer to those temporaries. Its responsibility is maintaining debuggable value expressions in RTL independently of the heavier full variable-location dataflow pass in var-tracking.c.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/valtrack.h, which defines the dead-debug bookkeeping types and declares the exported helpers, this source file implements the RTL debug-value tracking transformations themselves, such as propagating substitutions through DEBUG_INSNs, cleaning auto-inc/dec expressions, and creating debug temporaries when registers die.
